summary: The design fits the existing wiki direction, but its main risks are metadata lifecycle consistency, backend/federation support, and startup import costs. Several source paths currently discard or reshape frontmatter, so body-only reindexing cannot recover all entities. The contracts for canonical statuses, identity, time periods, and output atomicity need to be made explicit before implementation.

suggestions.title: Make page attributes part of the page write lifecycle
suggestions.rationale: Current WikiPageRecord has no attribute payload, while upsert_pages, replace_source_slice, and delete_page mutate pages in their own transactions. A separate attribute write can leave stale rows after re-ingest or pruning. Add a typed attribute payload and update/delete it in the same backend transaction as the page, or define one atomic write-batch API.

suggestions.title: Handle missing page_attrs tables despite keeping schema version 3
suggestions.rationale: The current migration probe checks only _MIGRATION_COLUMNS and schema_version. A pre-existing v3 database missing page_attrs may be repaired on a writable open through schema replay, but read-only foreign planes skip that path; federation only checks migrated columns. Add table-presence checks to migration/staleness detection and test a v3 plane without page_attrs in both writable and read-only modes.

suggestions.title: Extract attributes before source-specific body transformations
suggestions.rationale: vault_scan uses note.frontmatter for summaries but _note_body stores only title, tags, aliases, and note.content; repo_scan wraps raw content beneath a generated heading; legacy ingest can emit no frontmatter. A generic parser over stored body therefore cannot consistently recover typed metadata. Normalize frontmatter at each source boundary and carry attrs on FileSlice/WikiPageRecord rather than relying on body parsing.

suggestions.title: Define an explicit task entity mapping
suggestions.rationale: SDD ingestion currently emits category task pages with status embedded only in markdown, while the proposed entity vocabulary omits task. Without a rule, in-progress SDD tasks cannot appear in the brief or be indexed by status. Either add task as a first-class entity type or explicitly normalize task pages to deliverables with a documented status mapping.

suggestions.title: Specify canonical status and identity normalization before implementing collectors
suggestions.rationale: Jira IssueFrontmatter preserves arbitrary raw statuses, ledger has open/claimed/closed/superseded, and ADR records have separate source_status and review_status. The design needs complete per-entity canonical enums, unknown-status behavior, and precedence rules. Likewise, current SDD ingestion marks pages as agent:sdd-ingest rather than preserving a human author, so the stated --me semantics need a real source field or a documented limitation.

suggestions.title: Choose and document a backend contract for attributes
suggestions.rationale: BaseWikiStore supports SQLite, memory, ArangoDB, and Postgres implementations, while page_attrs is proposed as a SQLite table. A standup collector operating through BaseWikiStore cannot query attributes uniformly across configured backends or federated namespaces unless every backend gains the contract. Otherwise explicitly constrain indexed entity queries to local SQLite and define the foreign-plane fallback behavior.

suggestions.title: Audit the hook import graph instead of only lazily registering standup
suggestions.rationale: cli.py currently imports LedgerService, fix_planner, and ledger events at module import time, and project.py imports decisions.models at module import time. LazyCommands protects decisions.cli, but adding a lazy standup group alone does not guarantee the claude-hook p50 budget. Move heavy ledger/decision imports behind command execution or isolate lightweight configuration models, then measure the hook import path.

suggestions.title: Add standup configuration to both base and environment-overlay schemas
suggestions.rationale: WikiProjectConfig and WikiEnvOverlay use extra=forbid. Adding standup.default_language and ticket_status_map only to the JSON reader will make valid config files fail validation or prevent environment-specific overrides. Define a typed nested config, serialization defaults, merge behavior, and validation for language and status-map keys.

suggestions.title: Make period boundaries and brief writes deterministic and recoverable
suggestions.rationale: day|week|month requires an explicit timezone, week-start rule, inclusive horizon, and injectable clock; current timestamps and Jira dates use UTC/offset-aware values. The proposed page id and separate markdown file also permit concurrent runs or crashes to leave divergent outputs. Use the existing wiki writer lock, deterministic snapshot identity, atomic file replacement, and a defined source of truth for delta calculation.

suggestions.title: Treat wiki_standup as an explicit mutating MCP operation
suggestions.rationale: The current MCP factory registers tools from create_wiki_tools against a potentially federated store, while the proposed tool writes a local brief page and an external file. Its schema should state write behavior, local-plane routing, idempotency, partial-failure results, and whether confirmation or dry-run is required; the slash-command asset and checked-in command must be updated together.

suggestions.title: Bound and sanitize the optional LLM summary input
suggestions.rationale: The deterministic sections can contain arbitrary Jira, vault, memory, and ledger text, including secrets or prompt-injection instructions. Pass only a bounded structured projection to the model through the existing AbstractClient/PageIndex adapter, record model failure as a diagnostic, and guarantee the deterministic brief is written even when the call times out or returns invalid text.

suggestions.title: Build a cross-source and migration test matrix before collector implementation
suggestions.rationale: Existing tests cover v1-to-current schema migration, SDD task pages, backend metadata, and fixed MCP tool counts, but not attribute replacement/deletion, missing-table v3 upgrades, frontmatter aliases, federated read-only planes, period boundaries, delta closure, or dual-output failure. Add deterministic fixtures and contract tests for SQLite, memory, and any supported remote backend, plus hook import timing and model-absent fallback.
